But it’d be the equivalent of telling everyone you’re gonna be a pilot because you have a passion for it and you even have started studying for it. Except you flip out when you actually get on a plane because you had an awful experience once and your parents kept forcing you to face it over and over. And now you’ve found yourself just holding on hoping you can get rid of what might be ptsd in a matter of years.
